behavior: Factors authorship/3.0.0 duplicate-key rejection, metadata validation, identity classification, and line-attribution range parsing into one native classifier shared by OTLP mapping and query inspection.
Builds source-only and declared-session partitions without TelemetryRecord or encoded OTLP intermediates.
Scopes declared session evidence to a digest of native repository identity and never promotes legacy prompts, humans, or unresolved references into sessions.
Preserves supplied SourceId, revision, and GitNote locator on every source reference.
Replicates the bridge-provided canonical GitRepositoryIdentity association onto every output partition, falling back to the admitted local source path only for direct synthetic callers.
Emits only control, session metadata, and attribution facets with unavailable timestamps; no messages, turns, tools, timings, or transcript facts are fabricated.
Retains sensitive session names/models and attribution author/file details only under the corresponding ContentAccess fields; attribution parts capability is declared.
focused_tests: declared session versus source-only attribution classification
content consent for identity and file details
malformed, duplicate-key, unsupported-schema, and unsupported-input failures
pinned locator/revision preservation and repeated snapshot consistency
unrun_checks: All startup, build, test, lint, and formatter commands were intentionally not run under the convergence packet.
PM owns QuerySource bridge integration and composed validation.
